panels.title: API Connected
panels.description: API login only (mikrotik_up / mikrotik_connected). Prefer Scrape OK for full collector success.

panels.title: Scrape OK
panels.description: 1 if no collector errors this scrape. Partial failures can leave mikrotik_up=1 while this is 0.

panels.title: Scrape Duration
panels.description: Last scrape duration. Spikes near -scrape.timeout often mean partial collector timeouts.

panels.title: Collector Errors
panels.description: Per-collector failure flags from the last scrape.

panels.title: Collector Supported
panels.description: 1 if collector enabled/available on the device for this scrape. Optional collectors stay 0/absent when collect_*=false — that is not a scrape failure.

panels.title: Station Connected (worst)
panels.description: Worst-case across selected station/unknown radios (min). Includes role=unknown when mode is missing. 0 means at least one link is down.

panels.title: AP Connected (worst)
panels.description: Worst-case AP connected (equals radio running for APs). Empty when no AP interfaces match.

panels.title: Active Clients
panels.description: Sum of active clients across selected wireless interfaces.

targets.expr: min(mikrotik_wireless_interface_signal_strength_dbm{instance="$instance", name=~"$wireless_iface"} and on(instance, name) mikrotik_wireless_interface_info{instance="$instance", role=~"station|unknown", name=~"$wireless_iface"})

panels.title: Station Signal (worst)
panels.description: Minimum (worst) station/unknown signal. Alert contract: < -80 dBm.

targets.expr: min(mikrotik_wireless_interface_signal_to_noise_db{instance="$instance", name=~"$wireless_iface"} and on(instance, name) mikrotik_wireless_interface_info{instance="$instance", role=~"station|unknown", name=~"$wireless_iface"})

panels.title: Station SNR (worst)
panels.description: Minimum station/unknown SNR. Alert contract: < 20 dB.

panels.title: Noise Floor (worst)
panels.description: Maximum (worst) noise floor. Alert contract: > -70 dBm.

panels.title: Channel Width
panels.description: Operational channel width gauge (not an info label). Watch for unexpected fallback (e.g. 80→40).

panels.title: Station Tx CCQ (worst)
panels.description: Legacy wireless CCQ; often absent on wifiwave2. Alert contract: < 70%.

panels.title: Station Rx CCQ (worst)
panels.description: Legacy wireless CCQ; often absent on wifiwave2.

panels.title: Wireless Interface Signal / Noise (dBm)
panels.description: Signal and noise floor in dBm. SNR is on a separate panel (dB).

panels.title: Wireless Interface CCQ
panels.description: Empty on wifiwave2 when the device does not report CCQ.

panels.title: Client SNR
panels.description: Alert contract: < 20 dB.

panels.title: OSPF Neighbors Full
panels.description: Empty/No data when OSPF collector is disabled or unsupported — not the same as zero Full neighbors.

panels.title: OSPF Neighbors Not Full
panels.description: Empty/No data when OSPF collector is disabled or unsupported.

targets.expr: mikrotik_bgp_peer_uptime_seconds{instance="$instance", name=~"$bgp_peers"} * on(instance, name) group_left(routing_instance) mikrotik_bgp_peer_info{instance="$instance", name=~"$bgp_peers", disabled="false"}

mikrotik_bgp_peer_prefix_count{instance="$instance", name=~"$bgp_peers"} * on(instance, name) group_left(routing_instance) mikrotik_bgp_peer_info{instance="$instance", name=~"$bgp_peers", disabled="false"}

rate(mikrotik_bgp_peer_updates_received_total{instance="$instance", name=~"$bgp_peers"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance, name) group_left(routing_instance) mikrotik_bgp_peer_info{instance="$instance", name=~"$bgp_peers", disabled="false"}

rate(mikrotik_bgp_peer_withdraws_received_total{instance="$instance", name=~"$bgp_peers"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance, name) group_left(routing_instance) mikrotik_bgp_peer_info{instance="$instance", name=~"$bgp_peers", disabled="false"}
min(mikrotik_bgp_peer_state{instance="$instance", name=~"$bgp_peers"} and on(instance, name) mikrotik_bgp_peer_info{instance="$instance", name=~"$bgp_peers", disabled="false"})

panels.title: State (worst)
panels.description: Worst-case BGP state across selected enabled peers (min). 0 means at least one peer is not Established. routing_instance disambiguation is on the other BGP panels; peer gauges are keyed by name (multi-VRF same name can collide in the exporter).

title: MikroTik Router Overview
description: MikroTik RouterOS overview for ros-exporter. Shows API Connected (mikrotik_up) vs Scrape OK (mikrotik_scrape_success), system/health, interfaces, and optional wireless/optics/OSPF/BGP collectors. Pin this JSON by release tag or commit SHA/checksum in ansible-infrastructure; do not pull a mutable main tip blindly.
